title: Formulation white-space opportunity grid
basis: Patent-landscape density + TKDL classical exposure + dosage-form novelty (Nano/Liposomal/phytosome = least crowded) derived from the indexed WIPO metadata, Indian patent landscape and TKDL prior-art corpus.

cells.rationale: Near-saturated plain turmeric capsule patent space.
Topical curcumin gels present moderate window.
Oral neem supplements exist but standardisation gaps remain.
Non-pesticidal neem gel formulations are sparsely patented.
Nano-neem delivery has high white-space — early-mover window.
Tulsi extract capsule space is under-patented vs. classical fame.
Tulsi-based mucoadhesive gels show clear white space.
Nano-tulsi phytosome is a genuine blue-ocean zone.
Ashwagandha capsules are dense — differentiation needed.
Topical ashwagandha gels are minimal in the landscape.
Nano-ashwagandha (withanolide) delivery is a clear gap.
